people.name: Ezra
people.line: Priest; scribe; led a group of exiles back to Jerusalem.

translations.web: Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all who could hear with understanding, on the first day of the seventh month.
translations.bsb: On the first day of the seventh month, Ezra the priest brought the Law before the assembly of men and women and all who could listen and understand.
translations.kjv: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the congregation both of men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
translations.asv: And Ezra the priest brought the law before the assembly, both men and women, and all that could hear with understanding, upon the first day of the seventh month.
